description:
What is the shape of one metric? Returns histogram buckets (count + share) plus summary stats.

Metric: one of lcp, inp, cls, fcp, ttfb (field CWV), or a scalar technique path when available.

Filter: same as get_metrics (device, cms, framework, cdn, provider). No group_by — call get_metrics with group_by to compare segments, then get_histogram per segment if needed.

filter.description: AND filters. Omit for all sites in the dataset. Keys: device (all|phone|desktop; mobile = phone), cms, framework, cdn, provider (key), provider_category (e.g. analytics — use with provider or alone is not enough; prefer group_by for rankings).

cdn.description: Only sites on this CDN key (cloudflare, origin, …).

cms.description: Only sites on this CMS key (wordpress, shopify, wix, …).

device.description: CrUX device slice: phone (mobile and smartphone are the same), desktop or all. Default: all. Any other value is refused (there is no tablet slice).

framework.description: Only sites that include this JS framework key (react, vue, jquery, …).

provider.description: Only sites that load this third-party provider key (google_analytics_4, …).

metric.description: lcp | inp | cls | fcp | ttfb, or a contract scalar path.

name: get_histogram
